name: intelligence-reference-set
status: DRAFT - reviewed_by_human=false on every record; NOT ground truth until reviewed
caveats: Web search was standard-mode and US-indexed; coverage of Australian incidents is partial and several exact times were not found.
tjr_detection uses regex title matches; counts are indicative and can over- or under-match.
TJR collected_at is batch time, so 'time to detection' bundles source publication, feed polling and collection lag.
published_at values reflect the 2026-11-24 +10h RSS repair (backup table public.backup_rss_published_at_20261124); an initial pass was run pre-repair and every timestamp was re-pulled afterwards.
